mapper.select: SELECT * FROM merchant_payment_account WHERE merchant_id = #{merchantId} AND is_default = 1 LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO merchant_payment_account (merchant_id, account_type, account_name, account_number, bank_name, bank_branch, is_default, status, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{merchantId}, #{accountType}, #{accountName}, #{accountNumber}, #{bankName}, #{bankBranch}, #{isDefault}, #{status}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.update: UPDATE merchant_payment_account SET is_default = CASE WHEN id = #{id} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, update_time = NOW() WHERE merchant_id = #{merchantId}
